modules.title: Introduction to Trigonometry (Advanced)
modules.html:
Trigonometric identities, equations and the sine and cosine rules. This section covers introduction to trigonometry (advanced).

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of trigonometry (advanced).
  • Be able to explain trigonometry (advanced) in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: Find the sum of the first 10 terms of the AP: $5, 8, 11, ...$
A: 185 — Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: 185.

Q: If $$ A = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 3 & 4 \end{pmatrix} $$, find $$ |A| $$.
A: 5 — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 5.
